description: Discard schedule 'one from four races scored, two from eight': with three races scored, no score is excluded.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 A2.1: the notice of race or sailing instructions may provide 'that a specified number of scores will be excluded if a specified number of races are scored'. This vector's schedule excludes one score from four races scored and two from eight, so fewer than four excludes none. A4 scores the places.
working: Three races scored is below the schedule's first threshold (four), so the discard count is 0.
No two nets are equal: A, B, D, C. The same three races open the first-threshold and second-threshold vectors.
